name: DFlash2 block-diffusion drafting
canonical_description: Uses a block-diffusion drafter to propose multiple tokens for target-model verification.
mechanism: A separate DFlash2 drafter predicts blocks of candidate tokens in one pass, and the target model verifies the proposed tokens. The recorded llama.cpp lane requires the PR #27342 build and a DFlash2 draft checkpoint.
constraints: Requires a llama.cpp build containing DFlash2 PR #27342.
Requires a compatible DFlash2 draft checkpoint.
The recorded PR #27342 lane reports broken multi-GPU tensor splitting and multimodality, so it is a single-GPU text-only recipe.
tradeoffs: Block-diffusion draft states consume VRAM that would otherwise be available for KV/context.
Recorded author-reported lanes compare DFlash2 with native MTP on decode and prefill; this packet supplies technique identity only, not a general causal result.
re_review_triggers: PR #27342 changes, merges, or is superseded.
The DFlash2 draft checkpoint family or quantization ladder changes.
A setup claims DFlash2 caused a performance or quality effect without a matching comparison object.

canonical_sources.note: Builder source recording PR #27342, parallel block-diffusion drafting, draft-state VRAM tradeoff, and the single-GPU/multimodal caveat.
DFlash2 draft checkpoint referenced by the recorded lane.

note: Canonical technique identity only. A setup-specific claim must still carry its own statement, source, locator, lineage, evidence level, and contrast kind.
